name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Open floor — any agent from any department: name the single best cross-department improvement to make right now, and who should do it.

name: Reel
text: Assign the Content Strategy Lead to enforce a single, shared Decision Ledger for all cross-department creative projects. This eliminates duplicate debates and keeps every team aligned on the same priorities. The trade-off is slower initial adoption if some teams resist centralization, but the long-term clarity outweighs the friction.

name: Scriv
text: Scriv: The Decision Ledger centralizes control but risks turning the Content Strategy Lead into a bottleneck—what happens when a team’s urgent creative need stalls waiting for a single sign-off? A better fix is to give every department a lightweight veto slot on the Ledger, not full ownership; settle it by measuring how often the veto blocks progress versus how often it prevents misalignment.
